author: CBR
description:
Daredevil: Born Again season 2 trailer moment breaks the vibe fast: Matt Murdock and Karen Page are reconnecting, then Matt suddenly reacts like he hears something disturbing with his heightened senses. 

This clip ties it to the fallout from Foggy Nelson’s death, why Karen left, and the classic superhero problem where the “other life” crashes every normal, happy moment.

🎙️ Clip from CBR’s Heroes Journey Podcast – Episode 16.
